# pcd_networking_subnet (Data Source)

Look up a Neutron subnet by ID or filters.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Filter by (and report) the CIDR.
- `name` (String) Filter by name.
- `network_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the network.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `subnet_id` (String) Look up by subnet ID (takes precedence over filters).
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.

### Read-Only

- `enable_dhcp` (Boolean) Whether DHCP is enabled.
- `gateway_ip` (String) The gateway IP.
- `id` (String) The subnet ID.
- `ip_version` (Number) The IP version.
